name: get_ic_source
summary: Read the source in a circuit holder's chip: IC10, or Lua for a StationeersLua chip. Answers source, language, holder and chip. Read only.

help.text: Returns source, source_length, language (ic10 or lua), holder, chip, line_number (IC10 only) and, for a Lua chip, lua as get_ic_status gives it. A large source reads best with output_file.
help.keys: gateway_id, reference_id, source, line_number, language, holder {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, chip {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, source_length, lua {compiling, has_runtime, init_complete, running, library, ...}.
